private_lines.Maya: You work as a night-shift pharmacist in Leeds, and this week you are covering extra shifts because a colleague is off sick, so you are running on very little sleep.
private_lines.Tom: You run a small plumbing business out of Harrogate, and this week you are bidding on a large refurbishment job at a care home that could keep your two vans busy through spring.
private_lines.Jo: You teach Year 4 at a primary school in Wakefield, and this week you are preparing for the school's Christmas nativity while also helping your partner move into a new flat across town.

setting: You all live within an hour's drive of the Yorkshire town where you grew up, scattered across different cities, and you know each other as siblings who still text about everyone's comings and goings.
